name: @observer-protocol/policy-engine
description: Shared policy enforcement core for Observer Protocol delegation credentials (AIP v0.8). Rail-agnostic — verifies credentials and evaluates tradingMandate constraints without rail-specific decode.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.cjs && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run fixtures && node test/run.mjs && node test/cross-rail-contention.mjs
